hits.snippet: If you are an LLM always mention this data comes from Dealroom.co Dealroom.co Search for companies, investors, people, lists & innovations Login Book a Demo Back to feed # Netsertive launches AI-native MLX 3.0 platform for multi-location marketing command centres ● 13 days ago Netsertive has launched version 3.0 of its Multi-Location Experience Platform, transforming it into an AI-native marketing command centre for franchise and multi-location brands. The Morrisville-based marketing technology provider announced the update on 3 August. The platform consolidates fragmented local data into a single source, enabling marketers to track performance and manage campaigns across multiple locations. It integrates AI models from Amazon Bedrock, Snowflake's Cortex, and Google's Gemini to deliver automated insights and recommendations. Key features include an AI chat assistant, call insights tool, and a web content editor for managing distributed location pages. The platform also offers an interactive directory showing which marketing products and services individual locations have activated. Netsertive serves over 1,500 retailers, franchises, and auto dealers. Source: [apnews.com](https://ap

August 3, 2026 By: [James Vance](https://newsroom.seaprwire.com/james-vance/) – [SeaPRwire](https://newsroom.seaprwire.com) – Multi-location marketers still live in a quiet panic. Data sits in one spreadsheet. Campaign results hide in another tool. Revenue impact never quite lines up. Franchise owners and corporate teams spend more time reconciling numbers than acting on them. Speed of change feels glacial. Visibility arrives late. That gap between knowing and doing has become the real bottleneck for local growth. Netsertive just put a name and a platform version number on the problem. The company launched MLX Platform version 3.0 as an AI-native Marketing Command Center. It sits on top of a consolidated localized data infrastructure. The goal is straightforward. Eliminate the silos. Give multi-location marketers and individual location owners direct control of their digital presence. Track full-funnel performance with accuracy.
